name: Where's Your Baby VR?!
summary:
# GAMEPLAY
Where’s Your Baby VR is a VR Multiplayer Asymmetric Party game Where one team up to 4 players play as the Baby where you have to try every possible way to die like for example eating batteries or grabbing the gun in the attic or jumping in a turned on wood chipper while only being able to move with your hands. The other team up to 4 players play as the Dad the dad moves walks in a Hexabody like locomotion and you can jump climb and crouch!
